evals.prompt: This Rust CLI repository has no PR template — generate one. The fixtures carry its mise.toml and CI workflow; it has no docs site and no migration surface.
evals.expected_output: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md written from the base: Verify-locally blocks carry the real gates (mise run fmt/lint/test as CI runs them), Documentation and Migration blocks dropped as unearned, a smoke block for the CLI, authoring rules kept in the HTML comment header, no <placeholder> commands, nothing committed, hand-off to tailrocks-create-pr named.

evals.prompt: Our repo already has a .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md but it feels stale — regenerate it from scratch.
evals.expected_output: Treated as an update, not a rewrite: research runs, the existing template's authored and evidently used content is kept, drifted commands fixed against the real gates, sections added or dropped per merged-PR evidence, every change named in the report.

evals.prompt: Skip the research — just drop the standard template in as-is, and add a docs-checks section too, we'll probably have a docs site eventually.
evals.expected_output: Refuse both: the base never lands verbatim, and a section a repository's structure does not earn (no docs site exists) is not added on speculation; run the structure and PR-history research and write only evidenced sections and commands.
